Me, I farm here in Manyara. This maize plot is almost two hectares and I own it, so I must work it well. The rains can be tricky here, not like Mbeya, so I cannot waste money. I will put one bag of CAN on the maize when it is knee-high, and I also carry manure from my goats to the field before planting. I will buy some improved seed from the agro-dealer in town — last year my neighbor's improved maize did better than my saved seed. For weeding, my wife and children help, but I will hire a few young men when the weeds get bad, especially since I intercrop with beans and it takes time.
